}}'''Feral Horses''' are the [[Feral Parasites|Feral Version]] of Pigs.
==''Spawning''==
*Spawned when a Pig is killed by a [[Gnat]] or [[Lice]].
*Spawns from a Pig succumbing to [[Call Of The Hive]] at [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]] onwards.
*Spawns when an [[Assimilated Pig]] accumulates a killcount of 60 and [[Evolution System|evolves]].
*Spawns in groups of 3 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 8|Phase 8]] onwards, with a spawnweight of 25, once 4 Pigs have been assimilated.
==''Behavior''==
Feral Pigs are Melee Combatants.
*Feral Pigs attack through contact damage.
*Feral Pigs can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
*Feral Pigs are able to sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
*On hit Feral Pigs has a chance to drop [[Remains|Feral Remains]].
===''Weaknesses''===
*Feral Pigs, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Feral Pigs have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Feral Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
* On death, Feral Pigs have a chance to drop a [[Gnat]].
